page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.13xlarge is a compute-optimized instance virtualized via KVM on the x86_64 architecture. The server features 52 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. System memory totals 96.0 GB, which provides an allocation of 1.85 GB of RAM per vCPU. Networking interfaces deliver a baseline throughput of 12 Gbps, and the configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This server does not bundle local disk storage or GPU accelerators, meaning persistent filesystem operations rely entirely on attached network block volumes. The compute-focused ratio of under 2 GB of memory per core targets thread density rather than in-memory caching capacity. This hardware distribution reduces idle memory costs for compute-heavy applications.

The configuration is structured for parallel CPU-intensive workloads that require sustained processing capability without local IOPS requirements. Representative use cases include distributed batch computational pipelines, software compilation clusters, continuous integration workers, and compute-focused backend services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.13xlarge is a compute-optimized KVM-based virtual server designed for CPU-intensive parallel workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, the instance provides 52 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory, establishing a memory-to-core allocation of 1.85 GB per thread. The server contains no local storage and includes zero discrete GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage infrastructure. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps with no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The resource profile emphasizes computational density over memory capacity, making it appropriate for multi-threaded batch workloads, software compilation jobs, continuous integration agents, and stateless application tiers.
